summary: Nyxoah SA filed a Form 6-K reporting the commencement of a leadership transition process. On June 4, 2026, the company announced that CEO Olivier Taelman and the Board decided to transition to a U.S.-based CEO. The Board has launched a search for a new U.S.-based CEO; Taelman will remain engaged during the transition, leading daily operations and supporting onboarding. No terms (stake, price) are applicable. The filing also includes routine capital updates (ATM program, prior raises). This is a forced/abrupt CEO departure event—not a routine meeting or circular. Watch for appointment of new CEO and any strategic shift in the U.S. commercial focus.
